children: may rise into a range of $110.91 to $111.91 per barrel, as suggested by a projection analysis.
Despite the sharp fall during the previous trading session, the market managed to stabilize around a support at $106.26 and break above a resistance at $109.08.
The swift recovery suggests an intact uptrend which may extend toward $111.91. A break below $109.08 may trigger a fall into the $107.34-$108.21 range.
On the daily chart, a bullish flag pattern has been confirmed, suggesting a target around $130. A rising channel points at a lower target of $117.80.

The projection analysis on the uptrend from $78.19 reveals a resistance at $110.24, the 100% level. The market has briefly pierced above this barrier. It is likely to eventually break it and rise toward the $114.92-$117.80 range.
